base_url.description: The base url of the Terraform client

notifications_context_path.description: URL path segment for notification-srv APIs (default: `notifications-srv`). Used by notification-srv resources and datasources (`cidaas_notifications_template_group`, `cidaas_notification_template`, `cidaas_notification_template_type`, service setups, graph datasources). Legacy `cidaas_template` / `cidaas_template_group` use `templates-srv` and ignore this setting.

accent_color.description: The accent color of the client. e.g., `#f7941d`. The value must be a valid hex colorThe default is set to `#ef4923`.

accept_roles_in_the_registration.description: A boolean flag that determines whether roles can be accepted during the registration process.

ad_providers.description: A list of Active Directory identity providers that users can authenticate with.

allow_disposable_email.description: Allow disposable email addresses. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.

allow_guest_login.description: Flag to specify whether guest users are allowed to access functionalities of the client. Default is set to `false`

allow_login_with.description: allow_login_with is used to specify the preferred methods of login allowed for a client.

allowed_logout_urls.description: Allowed logout URLs for OAuth2 client.

allowed_native_clients.description: Client IDs of native apps that may use session transfer (STT) with this client. Typically the browser or web client lists the mobile/native client's `client_id` so STTs issued for that native client are accepted.

allowed_origins.description: List of the origins allowed to access the client.

allowed_scopes.description: The URL of the company website. allowed_scopes is a required attribute. It must be provided in the main config or common_config

allowed_web_origins.description: List of the web origins allowed to access the client.

application_meta_data.description: A map to add metadata of a client.

auto_login_after_register.description: Automatically login after registration. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.

backchannel_logout_session_required.description: If enabled, client applications or RPs must support session management through backchannel logout.

background_uri.description: The URL to the background image of the client.

client_display_name.description: The display name of the client.

client_id.description: The client_id is the unqique identifier of the app. It's an optional attribute. If not provided, cidaas will gererate one for you and the state will be updated with the same

client_secret.description: The client secret of the app. If not provided and `client_secret_wo` is not set, cidaas will generate one for you and the state will be updated with the same. Note that this will be stored in the state file.

client_secret_wo.description: Write-Only equivalent of `client_secret`. The value is sent to cidaas on create and update but is not stored in plan or state. Cannot be set together with `client_secret`. Must be set together with `client_secret_wo_version`. When set, the auto-generation of `client_secret` is disabled and the value must be supplied by the user. Write-only arguments are supported in HashiCorp Terraform 1.11.0 and later.

client_secret_wo_version.description: Used together with `client_secret_wo` to trigger an update. Increment this value when an update to `client_secret_wo` is required.

client_type.description: The type of the client. The allowed values are SINGLE_PAGE, REGULAR_WEB, NON_INTERACTIVEIOS, ANDROID, WINDOWS_MOBILE, DESKTOP, MOBILE, DEVICE and THIRD_PARTY

company_name.description: The name of the company that the client belongs to.

company_website.description: The URL of the company website.

content_align.description: The alignment of the content of the client. e.g., `CENTER`. Allowed values are CENTER, LEFT and RIGHTThe default is set to `CENTER`.

custom_providers.description: A list of custom identity providers that users can authenticate with. A custom provider can be created with the help of the resource cidaas_custom_provider.

default_max_age.description: The default maximum age for the token in seconds. Default is 86400 seconds (24 hours).

enable_login_spi.description: If enabled, the login service verifies whether login spi responsded with success only then it issues a token.

enable_passwordless_auth.description: Enable passwordless authentication. Default is set to `true` while creating an app.

grant_types.description: The grant types of the client. The default value is set to `['implicit','authorization_code', 'password', 'refresh_token']`

group_id.description: The unique ID of the user group.

group_type.description: The unique ID of the user group.

match_condition.description: The match condition for the roles (AND or OR).

role_filter.description: A filter for roles within the group.

filters.description: An array of group role filters.

hints.description: Optional response hints for group verification: groupIds, rolesOfGroup, or allowedGroups.

match_condition.description: The match condition for the role restriction

id_token_lifetime_in_seconds.description: The lifetime of the id_token in seconds. Default is 86400 seconds (24 hours).

imprint_uri.description: The URL to the imprint page.

is_hybrid_app.description: Flag to set if your app is hybrid or not. Default is set to `false`. Set to `true` to make your app hybrid.

jwe_enabled.description: Flag to specify whether JSON Web Encryption (JWE) should be enabled for encrypting data.

login_providers.description: With this attribute one can setup login provider to the client.

login_spi.description: A map defining the Login SPI configuration.

media_type.description: The media type of the client. e.g., `IMAGE`. Allowed values are VIDEO and IMAGEThe default is set to `IMAGE`.

allowed_methods.description: Optional set of allowed MFA methods.

setting.description: Specifies the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) setting. Allowed values are 'OFF', 'ALWAYS', 'SMART', 'TIME_BASED' and 'SMART_PLUS_TIME_BASED'.

time_interval_in_seconds.description: Optional time interval in seconds for time-based Multi-Factor Authentication.

oauth_standard.description: Specifies the OAuth standard version to use. Allowed values: 'OAuth2.1', 'OAuth2.0'

policy_uri.description: The URL to the policy of a client.

primary_color.description: The primary color of the client. e.g., `#ef4923`. The value must be a valid hex colorThe default is set to `#f7941d`.

refresh_token_lifetime_in_seconds.description: The lifetime of the refresh token in seconds. Default is 15780000 seconds.

register_with_login_information.description: Register with login information. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.

require_auth_time.description: Boolean flag to specify whether the auth_time claim is REQUIRED in a id token.

required_fields.description: The required fields while registering to the client.

response_types.description: The response types of the client. The default value is set to `['code','token', 'id_token']`

saml_providers.description: A list of SAML identity providers that users can authenticate with.

social_providers.description: A list of social identity providers that users can authenticate with. Examples: Google, Facebook etc...

range.description: The range type for mandatory methods. Allowed value is one of ALLOF or ONEOF.

skip_until.description: The date and time until which the mandatory methods can be skipped.

skip_duration_in_days.description: The number of days for which the verification methods can be skipped (default is 7 days).

template_group_id.description: The id of the template group to be configured for commenication. Default is set to the system default group.

token_lifetime_in_seconds.description: The lifetime of the token in seconds. Default is 86400 seconds (24 hours).

tos_uri.description: The URL to the TOS of a client.

user_consent.description: Specifies whether user consent is required or not. Default is `false`

validate_phone_number.description: if enabled, phone number is validaed. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.

video_url.description: The URL to the video of the client.

web_message_uris.description: A list of URLs for web messages used.

block.description:
The App resource allows creation and management of clients in Cidaas system. When creating a client with a custom `client_id` and `client_secret` you can include the configuration in the resource. If not provided, Cidaas will generate a set for you. `client_secret` is sensitive data. Refer to the article [Terraform Sensitive Variables](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials/configuration-language/sensitive-variables) to properly handle sensitive information.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:apps_read
- cidaas:apps_write
- cidaas:apps_delete

-> **Note:** Write-Only argument `client_secret_wo` is available to use in place of `client_secret`. Write-only arguments are supported in HashiCorp Terraform 1.11.0 and later. [Learn more](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments).

consent_group_id.description: The `consent_group_id` to which the consent belongs.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the consent version was created.

enabled.description: The flag to enable or disable a speicific consent. By default, the value is set to `true`

id.description: The unique identifier of the consent resource.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the consent version was last updated.

block.description:
The Consent resource in the provider allows you to manage different consents within a specific consent group in Cidaas.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:tenant_consent_read
- cidaas:tenant_consent_write
- cidaas:tenant_consent_delete

created_at.description: The timestamp when the consent group was created.

group_name.description: The name of the consent group.

id.description: The unique identifier of the consent group.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the consent group was last updated.

block.description:
The Consent Group resource in the provider allows you to define and manage consent groups in Cidaas.
 Consent Groups are useful to organize and manage consents by grouping related consent items together.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:tenant_consent_read
- cidaas:tenant_consent_write
- cidaas:tenant_consent_delete

consent_id.description: The `consent_id` for which the consent version is created. It can not be updated for a specific consent version.

content.description: The content of the consent version associated with a specific locale.

locale.description: The locale for which the consent version is created. e.g. `en-us`, `de`.

url.description:
The url to the consent page of the created consent version.
Note that the attribute `url` is required only if the `consent_type` is set to **URL**.

consent_type.description: Specifies the type of consent. The allowed values are `SCOPES` or `URL`. It can not be updated for a specific consent version.

id.description: The unique identifier of the consent version.

required_fields.description:
A set of fields that are required for the consent. It can not be updated for a specific consent version.
Note that the attribute `required_fields` is required only if the `consent_type` is set to **SCOPES**.

scopes.description:
A set of scopes related to the consent. It can not be updated for a specific consent version.
Note that the attribute `scopes` is required only if the `consent_type` is set to **SCOPES**.

version.description: The version number of the consent. It can not be updated for a specific consent version.

block.description:
The Consent Version resource in the provider allows you to manage different versions of a specific consent in Cidaas.
 This resource also supports managing consent versions across multiple locales enabling different configurations such as URLs and content for each locale.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:tenant_consent_read
- cidaas:tenant_consent_write
- cidaas:tenant_consent_delete

key.description: The API key that will be used to authenticate the webhook request.The key that will be passed in the request header or in query param as configured in the attribute `placement`

placeholder.description: The attribute is the placeholder for the key which need to be passed as a query parameter or in the request header.

placement.description: The placement of the API key in the request (e.g., query).The allowed value are `header` and `query`.

apikey_details.description: Configuration for API key-based authentication. It's a **required** parameter when the auth_type is APIKEY.

auth_type.description: Type of authentication. Allowed values `APIKEY`, `CIDAAS_OAUTH2` and `TOTP`.

authorization_endpoint.description: The URL for authorization of the provider.

client_id.description: The client ID for Cidaas authentication.

cidaas_auth_details.description: Configuration for Cidaas authentication. It's a **required** parameter when the auth_type is CIDAAS_OAUTH2.

client_id.description: The client ID of the provider.

client_secret.description: The client secret of the provider. Exactly one of `client_secret` or `client_secret_wo` must be set. Note that this will be stored in the state file.

client_secret_wo.description: Write-Only equivalent of `client_secret`. The value is sent to cidaas on create and update but is not stored in plan or state. Must be set together with `client_secret_wo_version`. Write-only arguments are supported in HashiCorp Terraform 1.11.0 and later.

client_secret_wo_version.description: Used together with `client_secret_wo` to trigger an update. Increment this value when an update to `client_secret_wo` is required.

display_name.description: The display name of the provider.

logo_url.description: The URL for the provider's logo.

pkce.description: The flag to enable or disable pkce flow. By default, the value is set to `false`

provider_name.description: The unique identifier of the custom provider. This cannot be updated for an existing state.

scope_display_label.description: Display label for the scope of the provider.

recommended.description: Indicates if the scope is recommended.

required.description: Indicates if the scope is required.

scope_name.description: The name of the scope, e.g., `openid`, `profile`.

scopes.description: List of scopes of the provider with details

standard_type.description: Type of standard. Allowed values `OAUTH2` and `OPENID_CONNECT`.

token_endpoint.description: The URL to generate token with this provider.

key.description: The key used for TOTP authentication.

placeholder.description: A placeholder value for the TOTP.

placement.description: The placement of the TOTP in the request.The allowed value are `header` and `query`.

totp_details.description: Configuration for TOTP based authentication.  It's a **required** parameter when the auth_type is TOTP.

userinfo_endpoint.description: The URL to fetch user details using this provider.

userinfo_fields.description: Object containing various user information fields with their values. The userinfo_fields section includes specific fields such as name, family_name, address, etc., along with custom_fields allowing additional user information customization

userinfo_source.description: Source of userinfo. Allowed values are `IDTOKEN` and `USERINFOENDPOINT`.

block.description:
This example demonstrates the configuration of a custom provider resource for interacting with Cidaas.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:

allowed_roles.description: List of allowed roles in this group type.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the resource was created.

description.description: The `description` attribute provides details about the group type, explaining its purpose.

group_type.description: The unique identifier of the group type. This cannot be updated for an existing state.

role_mode.description: Determines the role mode for the user group type. Allowed values are `any_roles`, `no_roles`, `roles_required` and `allowed_roles`

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the resource was last updated.

block.description:
The Group Type, managed through the `cidaas_group_type` resource in the provider defines and configures categories for user groups within the Cidaas system.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:group_type_read
- cidaas:group_type_write
- cidaas:group_type_delete

created_at.description: The timestamp when the resource was created.

default_locale.description: The default locale for hosted pages e.g. `en-US`.

hosted_page_group_name.description: The name of the hosted page group. This must be unique across the cidaas system and cannot be updated for an existing state.

content.description: The conent of the hosted page.

hosted_page_id.description: The identifier for the hosted page, e.g., `register_success`.

locale.description: The locale for the hosted page, e.g., `en-US`.

url.description: The URL for the hosted page.

hosted_pages.description: List of hosted pages with their respective attributes

block.description:
The Hosted Page resource in the provider allows you to define and manage hosted pages within the Cidaas system.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:hosted_pages_write

description.description: Description of the template (10–600 characters per API validation).

id.description: Document id of the template (`_id` from the API).

locale.description: BCP47 locale (e.g. `en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`, `de-DE`). Use lowercase for the language subtag and uppercase for the region when present.

number.description: Optional template number suffix in id generation.

owner.description: Object owner: `client`, `admin`, `core`, or `system`. Omit to adopt the value returned by the API (e.g. seeded `default` templates are often `admin`). If set, apply returns that value even when the API stores another owner for system templates.

processing_type.description: Processing type when required by the template type (e.g. `CODE`, `LINK`).

subject.description: Email subject. Required for `email` channel in practice.

usage_type.description: Usage type when required by the template type.

user_group_ids.description: Restrict template access to these user groups.

verification_type.description: Verification type when required by the template type.

block.description:
Manages a **notification template** via **notification-srv** (`/templates`). This is separate from `cidaas_template` (legacy `templates-srv`).

**Import:** `terraform import cidaas_notification_template.NAME <template_document_id>`

category.description: The category of the template type. Allowed values are `cidaas` (system) or `custom`. System template types are pre-provisioned.

communication_methods.description: Communication methods supported by this template type. Use the same lowercase values as the API: `email`, `sms`, `ivr`, `push` (uppercase is accepted but normalized to lowercase). At least one is required.

context_attributes.description: Context attributes that can be used in templates. Map values should be `"required"` or `"allowed"`. Read-only for system template types.

created_time.description: The timestamp when the template type was created.

custom_attributes.description: Custom attributes that can be used in templates. Map values should be `"required"` or `"allowed"`. This is the only updatable field for system template types.

deactivatable.description: Whether templates of this type can be disabled.

description.description: Description of the template type. Must be between 10 and 600 characters. Cannot be updated for system template types.

id.description: The unique identifier of the template type resource.

msg_formats.description: Message format restrictions (`html`, `text`, `media`). Read-only for system template types.

owner.description: Object owner sent to notification-srv: `client`, `admin`, `core`, or `system` (lowercase JSON). Defaults to `client` for custom template types.

processing_types.description: Allowed processing types (e.g., `CODE`, `LINK`, `GENERAL`). Read-only for system template types.

system_attributes.description: System attributes that can be used in templates. Map values should be `"required"` or `"allowed"`. Read-only for system template types.

template_group_ids.description: Template group IDs this template type is restricted to. Empty means no restriction.

template_key.description: The unique identifier (template key) of the template type. This cannot be updated for an existing state. Must be uppercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

updated_time.description: The timestamp when the template type was last updated.

usage_types.description: Allowed usage types (e.g., `GENERAL`, `VERIFICATION_CONFIGURATION`). Read-only for system template types.

verification_types.description: Allowed verification types (e.g., `EMAIL`, `SMS`). Read-only for system template types.

block.description:
The `cidaas_notification_template_type` resource manages template type definitions in the cidaas system. Template Types define which attributes can be used in templates and which communication methods are supported.

**Important Notes:**
- System Template Types (category: `cidaas`) are pre-provisioned and cannot be created via Terraform
- For System Template Types, only `custom_attributes` can be modified
- Custom Template Types (category: `custom`) can be fully created and managed

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:templates_read
- cidaas:templates_write
- cidaas:templates_delete

has_remote_templates.description: Whether remote templates exist for this channel.

sender_address.description: Optional sender address (e.g. email from / SMS originator).

sender_name.description: Optional sender display name for this channel.

service_setup_id.description: Service setup (communication provider) id from notification-srv / tenant configuration.

comm_setting_email.description: EMAIL `commSettings` entry. On **update**, other channels are merged from the existing group; you may set only the channels you change. On **create**, notification-srv requires all four channels unless `commSettings` is omitted (server fills from copy source).

has_remote_templates.description: Whether remote templates exist for this channel.

sender_address.description: Optional sender address (e.g. email from / SMS originator).

sender_name.description: Optional sender display name for this channel.

service_setup_id.description: Service setup (communication provider) id from notification-srv / tenant configuration.

has_remote_templates.description: Whether remote templates exist for this channel.

sender_address.description: Optional sender address (e.g. email from / SMS originator).

sender_name.description: Optional sender display name for this channel.

service_setup_id.description: Service setup (communication provider) id from notification-srv / tenant configuration.

has_remote_templates.description: Whether remote templates exist for this channel.

sender_address.description: Optional sender address (e.g. email from / SMS originator).

sender_name.description: Optional sender display name for this channel.

service_setup_id.description: Service setup (communication provider) id from notification-srv / tenant configuration.

group_id.description: Template group id (`_id`). Immutable after create.

tg_type.description: Template group type: `cidaas`, `developer`, or `reminder`. `cidaas` — standard Cidaas platform emails (e.g. welcome, password reset). `developer` — custom emails you design, trigger (e.g. from a flow), and fill with your payload. `reminder` — scheduled follow-up when a user delays an action (e.g. email verification).

block.description:
Manages a **template group** via **notification-srv** (`/notifications-srv/templategroups`). This is separate from `cidaas_template_group` (legacy `templates-srv/groups`) and does not replace it.

Template **locales** are managed with **`cidaas_notifications_template_group_locale`** (copy on create, bulk-delete on destroy). Group create does not send `copy`; notification-srv may still seed locales from `default` per API rules.

**Scopes:** `cidaas:templates_read`, `cidaas:templates_write`, `cidaas:templates_delete` (and admin roles as enforced by notification-srv).

locale.description: Target locale in the group (BCP47, e.g. `en`, `de-DE`).

block.description:
Manages **one locale** in a notification-srv template group: copy templates on create and bulk-delete on destroy.

Use with **`cidaas_notifications_template_group`** (group metadata only). After group create, notification-srv may already have locales from `default`; if copy returns "already templates found", create succeeds when the locale appears in `templatefilters`.

Extra API locales not managed by locale resources are **not** auto-removed.

**Scopes:** `cidaas:templates_read`, `cidaas:templates_write`, `cidaas:templates_delete`.

id.description: Unique identifier of the password policy.

block_compromised.description: Flag to block passwords that have been compromised.

expiration_in_days.description: The number of days allowed before a password must be changed.

notify_user_before_in_days.description: Number of days before password expiry to notify the user.

deny_usage_count.description: The reuse limit specifies the maximum number of times a user can reuse a previous password.

strength_regexes.description: The regular expression to enforce the minimum and maximum character count, minimum number of numeric and special characters and whether to include lowercase or uppercase letters in a password.

password_policy.description: The password policy configuration. All attributes are optional except strength_regexes. If not provided, default values will be applied.

policy_name.description: The name of the password policy.

block.description:
The Password Policy resource in the provider allows you to manage the password policy within the Cidaas.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:password_policy_read
- cidaas:password_policy_write
- cidaas:password_policy_delete

base_data_type.description: The base data type of the field. This is computed property.

claimable.description: Flag to mark if a field is claimable. Defaults set to `true`

consent_refs.description: List of consents(the ids of the consent in cidaas must be passed) in registration. The data type must be `CONSENT` in this case

data_type.description: The data type of the field. This cannot be modified for an existing resource. Allowed values are `TEXT`,`NUMBER`,`SELECT`,`MULTISELECT`,`RADIO`,`CHECKBOX`,`PASSWORD`,`DATE`,`URL`,`EMAIL`,`TEXTAREA`,`MOBILE`,`CONSENT`,`JSON_STRING`,`USERNAME`,`ARRAY`,`GROUPING`,`DAYDATE`,

enabled.description: Flag to mark if a field is enabled. Defaults set to `true`

initial_date.description: The initial date. Applicable only for DATE attributes. Example format: `2024-06-28T18:30:00Z`.

initial_date_view.description: The view of the calender. Applicable only for DATE attributes. Allowed values: `month`, `year` and `multi-year`

max_date.description: The maximum date a user can select. Applicable only for DATE attributes. Example format: `2024-06-28T18:30:00Z`.

max_length.description: The maximum length of a string type attribute.

min_date.description: The earliest date a user can select. Applicable only for DATE attributes. Example format: `2024-06-28T18:30:00Z`.

min_length.description: The minimum length of a string type attribute

regex.description: The regex for max_length and min_length for the data types TEXT and URL.

field_key.description: The unique identifier of the registration field. This cannot be modified for an existing resource.

field_type.description: Specifies whether the field type is `SYSTEM` or `CUSTOM`. Defaults to `CUSTOM`. This cannot be modified for an existing resource. `SYSTEM` fields cannot be created but can be modified. To modify an existing field import it first and then update.

internal.description: Flag to mark if a field is internal. Defaults set to `false`

is_searchable.description: Flag to mark if a field is searchable. Defaults set to `true`

attributes.description: The field attributes must be provided for the data_type SELECT, MULTISELECT and RADIO. it's an array of key value pairs. Example provided in the example section.

consent_label.description: required when data_type is CONSENT. Example provided in the example section.

locale.description: The locale of the field. example: de-DE.

max_length_msg.description: warning/error msg to show to the user when user exceeds the maximum character configured. This is applicable only for the attributes of base_data_type string.

min_length_msg.description: warning/error msg to show to the user when user don't provide the minimum character required. This is applicable only for the attributes of base_data_type string.

name.description: The name of the field in the local configured. for example: in **en-US** the name is `Sample Field` in de-DE `Beispielfeld`.

required_msg.description: Message shown when the field is required but empty. Must be provided when `required` is true. May also be set when `required` is false to pre-define translations for fields marked required at the application level.

local_texts.description: The localized detail of the registration field.

order.description: The display order of the field in the registration UI. When omitted, the API assigns an order.

overwrite_with_null_value_from_social_pr.description: Set to true if you want the value should be reset by identity provider. Defaults set to `false`

parent_group_id.description: The ID of the parent registration group. Defaults to `DEFAULT` if not provided.

read_only.description: Flag to mark if a field is read only. Defaults set to `false`

required.description: Flag to mark if a field is required in registration. Defaults set to `false`

scopes.description: The scopes of the registration field.

unique.description: Flag to mark if a field is unique. Defaults set to `false`

call_once.description: When true, the remote API is called once per session.

api_access_type.description: Authentication type: APIKEY, TOTP, BASIC_AUTH, CIDAAS_OAUTH2, or GEN_OAUTH2.

communication_ep.description: The remote API endpoint URL. Supports {{sub}} placeholder.

block.description: Required when api_access_type is APIKEY.

block.description:
Tenant-wide fraud-detection settings via `fraud-detection-srv/settings`. This resource exposes **`blocking_setting`**, **`repeated_login_blocking_mechanism`**, and **`rule_configuration.repeated_login_blocking_mechanism_enabled`** only; other fraud-detection API fields are not configurable here. Updates use HTTP PATCH (partial merge). Destroy only removes the resource from Terraform state; it does **not** reset settings in Cidaas.

State only stores attributes you set in Terraform. Remote values for omitted fields are not written to state (so apply matches partial configuration). After `terraform import`, the first refresh may load a full API snapshot into state until your `.tf` matches or you use `ignore_changes`.

Required OAuth scopes on the Terraform client: `cidaas:fds_settings_read`, `cidaas:fds_settings_write`.

id_token.description: A list of ID token claims that are optional.

client_secret_wo.description: Write-Only equivalent of `client_secret`. The value is sent to cidaas on create and update but is not stored in plan or state. Must be set together with `client_secret_wo_version`. Write-only arguments are supported in HashiCorp Terraform 1.11.0 and later.

enabled.description: A flag to enable or disable the social provider configuration. Set to `true` to enable and `false` to disable.

block.description:
The `cidaas_social_provider` resource allows you to configure and manage social login providers within Cidaas.
 Social login providers enable users to authenticate using their existing accounts from popular social platforms such as Google, Facebook, LinkedIn and others.

 Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client:
- cidaas:providers_read
- cidaas:providers_write
- cidaas:providers_delete

-> **Note:** Write-Only argument `client_secret_wo` is available to use in place of `client_secret`. Write-only arguments are supported in HashiCorp Terraform 1.11.0 and later. [Learn more](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments).

is_system_template.description: A boolean flag to decide between SYSTEM and CUSTOM template. When set to true the provider creates a SYSTEM template else CUSTOM

locale.description: The BCP47 locale of the template (e.g. `en-US`, `en-GB`, `de-DE`, or a language-only tag like `en`). Use lowercase for the language subtag and uppercase for the region when present. Must be one of the allowed locale tags; see the Allowed Locales section below. It cannot be updated for an existing state.
